channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Current heart attack screening tools missing 45 pc people at risk: Study
item.description: The study, led by Mount Sinai researchers in the US, exposed a major flaw in patient care and showed that relying on risk scores and symptoms alone may not help prevent the risk of a heart attack.

item.title: Dharmendra fans get emotional hearing his voice for last time in Ikkis poster
item.description: Ikkis makers shared a poster with Dharmendra

item.title: Gold prices jump over 1% on festive demand; silver spiked too
item.description: In early trade on the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), gold futures for December delivery were up 1 per cent at Rs 1,25,106 per 10 grams around 9:47 am. Silver prices also moved higher.

item.title: Labour reforms to create 77 lakh jobs, boost consumption by Rs 75,000 crore: SBI report
item.description: This would imply additional employment generation of 77 lakh people based on current labour force participation rate (15 years +) at 60.1 per cent and average working age population at 70.7 per cent across rural and urban workforce.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open flat as investors awaited fresh triggers
item.description: The Sensex slipped 76 points, or 0.09 per cent, to trade at 84,824 levels. Similarly, the Nifty dropped 29 points, or 0.11 per cent, to 25,931.

item.title: Rs 1.66 crore fake property deal case: J&K Crime Branch files chargesheet against 4 accused
item.description: It is further alleged that the accused subsequently inflated the sale price and extracted an additional Rs 50 lakh, bringing the total amount to Rs 1.66 crore. The complainants were neither handed possession of the property nor refunded their money. Investigation established that the accused hatched a criminal conspiracy and executed fraudulent documents to misappropriate the complainants

item.title: Volcanic ash disrupts air travel: Multiple flights cancelled in India
item.description: Several flights were cancelled, and the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) issued an urgent advisory to airlines and airports. IndiGo cancelled at least six domestic and international flights, while Akasa Air suspended its flights to Jeddah, Kuwait and Abu Dhabi for November 24 and 25.

item.title: Delhi-NCR air quality remains
item.description: The scenario in other NCR cities was similarly alarming. Noida and Greater Noida recorded AQI levels of 456 and 455, respectively, at 7:34 a.m., while Ghaziabad reported 454. In Haryana, Faridabad registered 444, and Gurugram stood at 404, indicating that poor air quality extends across the region.

item.title: Dining with Kapoors: Ranbir Kapoor eats fish, junglee mutton; fans ask if he lied about quitting non-veg, alcohol for Ramayana
item.description: Ranbir Kapoor, who was reportedly following a sattvic diet and had changed his lifestyle while shooting for the role of Lord Ram in Ramayana, has been facing flak for eating fish curry on Dining with the Kapoors.
